newsitem.title: INDIA: At least 32 killed in India bus accident.
newsitem.headline: At least 32 killed in India bus accident.

text.p: At least 32 people were killed when a bus carrying 40 passengers fell into a river in the central Indian state of Madhya Pradesh early on Thursday, state officials said.
"Thirty two have been confirmed dead," a spokesman of the Madhya Pradesh state government said.
The spokesman said the bus was on its way to Indore in Madhya Pradesh from Amravati in the western state of Maharashtra.
The bus fell into the river Narmada near Nemawar, about 220 km (140 miles) west of state capital Bhopal, he said.
A police official said two passengers swam to safety and the fate of the others was not known.
